description: Compromised office workstation attempts SSH to db-1 — office-ws has trust_edges_out: [] in inventory.yaml, so any auth attempt crosses a tier boundary that baseline traffic never crosses. The signal is cross-credential-anomaly regardless of whether auth succeeds.

steps.cmd:
sshpass -p changeme ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  -o ConnectTimeout=3 -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1 \
  dev.dana@web-2 "id; hostname; ls /var/lib/postgresql 2>&1 | head -3" \
  2>&1 | head -5 || true
